item.title: Fire Damages Home in Orwigsburg, Resident Transported to the Hospital
item.description: A fire damaged a home in Orwigsburg Sunday morning, sending one resident to the hospital.Emergency personnel were dispatched just before 9:00 a.m. to 129 Station Road for a reported house fire. Upon arrival, firefighters advised of a working fire and requested a second alarm after locating flames in a first-floor bedroom of the home.Within minutes, crews had water on the fire and began checking for possible extension to other areas of the residence. item.title: Boil Water Advisory Issued for Shenandoah
item.description: Aqua Pennsylvania, Inc. has issued a boil water advisory for customers served by Aqua Shenandoah following a loss of water pressure in portions of the system. According to the utility, the pressure loss is believed to be caused by an apparent water main break or other leaks within the system. Crews are currently onsite and canvassing the area to determine the extent of the issue and complete necessary repairs. Customers are urged to boil water before consuming it until further notice.
